2102: Goku's afternoon of fishing is interrupted by a bossy girl who is determined to get her hands on his most prized possession - a mysterious ball that belonged to his grandfather.
Goku and Bulma aren't the only ones looking for Dragon Balls. The little warrior runs into a couple of Emperor Pilaf's henchmen during his search for a late night snack.
Bulma gets annoyed when Goku slows things down to help a lost turtle, but his good deed could speed up their quest to collect the seven Dragon Balls.
Another Dragon Ball is discovered in a small village. Before Bulma can claim the fifth magic ball, Goku must fight with Oolong the Terrible!
Oolong joins the quest to locate the final two Dragon Balls, but the adventurers are interrupted by a desert dweller with ties to Goku's past.
The magic Dragon Balls are sought for many reasons. Oolong and Yamcha want success with women, Bulma wants a hot date, and Goku probably just wants something to eat.
Bulma's got a hunch about where to find another Dragon Ball. Unfortunately, it's guarded by the Ox-King, and he won't give it up unless he gets something in return.
Goku and Chi-Chi are sent to borrow a magic fan from Roshi. When the old master can't find it, he returns to Fire Mountain with his Kamehameha Wave!
Bulma's getting free stuff all over town, but it's not because she's so good looking. It seems her outfit reminds the villagers of a bad guy named Boss Rabbit.
As the adventurers close in on the seventh and final Dragon Ball, Bulma and Oolong argue over what their wish should be - but it might not even matter.
Goku, Bulma, and the others momentarily escape their prison only to find themselves trapped in a deadly game of pinball where Emperor Pilaf controls all the balls!
Pilaf demands revenge for his wasted wish, so he puts Oolong and company in a room designed to cook them alive! There's no way out - unless Goku can release the beast within!
The Emperor may have captured Goku's human form, but once the little man takes a look at the moon, nothing - except maybe a pair of scissors - can stop him!

With the Dragon Balls once again spread across the face of the Earth, the gang has split to pursue new adventures. While Bulma, Yamcha, Oolong, and Puar struggle through the desert after their plane crashes, Goku flies to Master Roshi's island to learn martial arts.
While in town on an errand to prove their worth to Master Roshi, Goku and Krillin rescue the young woman Launch and bring her back to Roshi's island.

Master Roshi takes Goku and Krillin to begin their martial arts training on a jungle island. Krillin cheats to beat Goku in the heated rivalry and wins, but soon has to pay a heavy price for his actions.
As part of their training, Goku and Krillin must deliver milk to a person who lives high up on a mountain.

Goku and Krillin's training continues as they till the ground with their bare hands, dodge a swarm of angry bees, and swim with sharks. Can Goku and Krillin survive the training to prepare for the World Martial Arts Tournament?
The greatest warriors from around the world are gathered to battle one another in the greatest martial arts tournament ever. Can Goku and Krillin make it past the Elimination Round?
The tournament is in full swing as Yamcha, Goku, and Krillin all compete to become one of the eight finalists.

The final eight competitors draw lots for their match-ups in the World Martial Arts Tournament. Krillin draws the first match against an unusually repulsively oaf named Bacterian. It will take some innovative strategy to beat this monstrous man.
The final matches continue with Jackie Chun defeating Yamcha and knocking him out of the tournament. But there is something mysterious about Jackie Chun.
Goku is set to fight the fierce warrior Giran. He manages to ward off Giran's powerful attacks until Giran takes Goku by surprise.
Jackie Chun and Krillin square off in the semi-final match. Unable to match Jackie in brute strength or speed, Krillin must use his wits.
Goku fights Nam, the poor farmer who has entered the tournament so that he can use the championship money to buy water for his drought-stricken village.
The final bout begins between Goku and Jackie Chun. It's a huge battle between master and student with only one winner!
The final match between Goku and Jackie Chun rages on for hours, the fighters matching technique for technique even as the sun begins to set.
The tournament has turned serious when Jackie Chun sent out his Kamehameha Wave that has destroyed half the arena and perhaps Goku with it.

Goku begins a search for his grandfather's Four-Star Dragon Ball and finds the adventure of a lifetime. The fate of an entire village rests on his shoulders as he braves the perilous desert to discover the secret of the mysterious Roaming Lake.

The race for the Dragon Balls continues, as Goku must battle Emperor Pilaf and his cohorts for control of the Four-Star ball. Amid the chaos rises a new enemy, a mysterious horde of villains who will stop at nothing to realize their lethal agenda.

Pilaf is back to his sneaky tricks to get his hands on a Dragon Ball, but he isn't the only one looking! The Red Ribbon Army is also on the hunt, and they'll destroy everything in their path to get what they want.

The Ox-King's been had! Now, Goku is here to straighten it out. Emperor Pilaf made an imposter of Goku in order to steal the prized Dragon Ball. But it won't be that easy this time. Goku and an entire army are out to stop him!

Goku explores a jungle paradise in search of the Four-Star Dragon Ball. Little does he know, the diabolical Colonel Silver is hot on his tail! And when the Red Ribbon Army carves a path of destruction through the jungle, it's clear they didn't come to monkey around!

Colonel Silver's troops scour land, sea, and air in search of the elusive Dragon Ball, but what they find is Goku! With the help of his Dragon Radar, Goku pinpoints the location of the ball and plucks it from under the noses of the Red Ribbon Army.

Goku is dragged into his most exciting adventure yet. The treacherous Red Ribbon Army threatens a peaceful village. Soldiers ravage the land in search of another Dragon Ball, destroying anything that gets in their way.
In an effort to repay the kindness of Suno and her mother, Goku vows to rescue their kidnapped Village Chief from the Red Ribbon Army's heavily fortified Muscle Tower.
Goku's quest to save the Village Chief from Muscle Tower is in danger of coming to an untimely end when he encounters the fourth-floor guard, Ninja Murasaki.
Fighting a ninja is difficult. Fighting five? Impossible! However, those are the odds Goku must face when Murasaki unveils his deadly trick of Separation!
Proving to be no match for Goku's skills on his own, Murasaki makes a desperate call for reinforcements. He summons the Red Ribbon Army's secret weapon, the monstrous Android Number 8!
Goku and Android Number 8 confront General White at the top of Muscle Tower. But the wily General sends the duo tumbling through a trap door into the darkness of floor number five.

Having bested all of White's tower guards, only one obstacle stands between Goku and his goal, the General himself. In order to save the Village Chief, Goku must match strength and wits against General White.
The gentle Android Number 8 is carrying a deadly secret inside of him, and a mysterious hermit, Dr. Flappe, may be his only chance at survival.
Goku's Dragon Radar is broken, and Bulma is the only one who knows how to fix it. He needs her help, but how will he ever find her in the sprawling urban maze of West City?

Goku arrives at Capsule Corporation, Bulma's home in West City. He's hoping to have the Dragon Radar repaired, but the broken device will soon be the least of his worries! The Red Ribbon Army and their hired thief, Hasky, are hot on his tail!

Goku and his friends celebrate by going to a spectacular amusement park. But the beautiful bounty hunter, Hasky, has Goku and his two Dragon Balls in her sights, and she intends to turn their day at Dream Land into a tragic nightmare!
Goku and Bulma find themselves on a uncharted desert. When Goku dives into the ocean waters to search for the magic ball, Bulma finds herself in deep trouble!
Goku and Bulma have located another Dragon Ball and travel to Master Roshi's island in hopes of finding some assistance.
Goku, Bulma and Krillin comb the depths of the deep blue sea, where a third Dragon Ball waits to be claimed.
Goku, Bulma and Krillin discover an ancient secret that promises great wealth, and even greater danger! The Red Ribbon Army is also on the prowl!
The Red Ribbon Army is in hot pursuit of Goku through the corridors of the Pirate Cave, where danger lurks around every corner in the form of booby-traps!
Goku, Bulma and Krillin discover an underwater cave port at the heart of the Pirate Cave, where a sword-wielding robot lurks in the shadows!
Krillin and Bulma must face General Blue alone! Can Goku make it to his friends in time to save them?
Goku, Bulma, and Krillin close in on the pirates' treasure, but they're not the only ones!
The Pirate Cave begins to collapse on top of Goku! But that's not even the worst of it, because there is an even greater menace that threatens to destroy our hero!

Goku, Bulma and Krillin return to Master Roshi's island for some much needed rest. However, they aren't the only ones who have survived. An old foe returns, and he won't stop until he has the Dragon Balls!
The bizarre characters of Penguin Village await Goku as he searches the countryside for General Blue and the three missing Dragon Balls!
General Blue has a plane to catch, but not before settling an old score with our hero!
The Red Ribbon Army tracks one of the Dragon Balls on a volcano island! However, a native is there to protect this sacred habitat and Goku is on his way as well!
The Red Ribbon Army hires Mercenary Tao to eliminate Goku. The two meet on the island of Korin.
Mercenary Tao made short work of Bora, but Goku won't prove to be so easy. Goku is determined to avenge his friend's death and hang on to the Dragon Balls.
Goku attempts to climb the Korin Tower in hopes of finding the Sacred Water. Legend has it that whoever drinks it will be rewarded with amazing new powers.
Goku pushes on in an attempt to capture the bottle of Sacred Water from Korin. Meanwhile, Mercenary Tao prepares for a rematch against Goku.
The fight of the century is about to begin when Goku and Mercenary Tao face off for a rematch.
What will Tao find at the top of the tower? And more importantly, what awaits Goku when the angry assassin comes back down?
Goku makes his way to the Red Ribbon Army headquarters to take the Dragon Balls from them.
Goku's best friends have decided to help him. Can this small group of good guys conquer the legions of evil that await them?
In an attempt to acquire two Dragon Balls, Goku must face Commander Red and his soldiers. The ultimate battle between good and evil begins!
Staff Officer Black is on the attack, and his sights are set on Goku. The showdown between good and evil comes to its thrilling conclusion!
Master Roshi sends Goku and his friends on a quest to find the mysterious Fortuneteller Baba. She possesses the power to find lost things.
Krillin must face-off against a warrior with real bite!
How do you fight someone you can't see? That's the problem Yamcha must face as he continues his fight against an invisible man!
Fortuneteller Baba unleashes a threat that will test the heroes' skills and bring them to the brink of destruction: the third fighter!
Goku has a big problem to solve: How can he defeat a 5,000-year-old mummy that has never been defeated? But this is only the third of Baba's fighters!
The battle for the last Dragon Ball continues! Now Goku has to face the fourth fighter and his deadly Devilmite Beam.
The final battle in Fortuneteller Baba's tournament has begun, and it is quickly proving to be one for the ages!
The battle between Goku and the masked fighter concludes in an unimaginable showdown that will forever change our hero. Meanwhile, Emperor Pilaf forges a plan to steal Goku's Dragon Balls once again.
The seventh Dragon Ball is in the possession of the greedy Emperor Pilaf and secured by his mechanized arsenal! Can Goku take the last ball?
Goku has collected all seven Dragon Balls! So it's off to the land of Korin to revive Upa's beloved father.
Goku gets into trouble when he meets Chao, a little girl who persuades him to save her village from the two dangerous criminals Plague and Terror.

Goku gets into the middle of a dispute between two martial arts schools, Chin-Star and Phantom-Fang. When Goku makes enemies with Sky Dragon, the leader of Phantom Fang, he must defend the Chin-Star School in a fight to determine the master of martial arts.
Goku's journey takes him to a small village terrorized by dozens of demons. The princess of the village was kidnapped by these fearsome creatures, and the king asks Goku for his help.
The monster InoShikaCho is coming for Goku!
Three years have passed since Master Roshi sent Goku off. But before the tournament begins, he must learn a difficult lesson about deception and betrayal.
Master Roshi and the rest of the gang head to the World Martial Arts Tournament but Goku is still missing. If he doesn't reach the sign-in booth on time, he won't get to compete!
The World Martial Arts Tournament begins! Among the competitors is a dangerous opponent who almost destroyed Goku in their first encounter. Get ready for action!
Out of 182 fighters, only 8 will survive the elimination round. As the battles continue, Goku, Krillin and Yamcha fight to stay on top!
The elimination round is over and Goku, Yamcha and Krillin are among the 8 finalists. The first round: Yamcha fights against his new rival, Tien!
The first fight in the quarterfinals is in full swing, with Yamcha challenging Tien. With these two warriors in battle, one thing is for sure: sparks will fly!
Man-Wolf and Jackie Chun face each other in the second match of the quarterfinals. For Man-Wolf this fight is not about the martial arts title. It is about revenge!
In the third fight of the quarterfinals Krillin faces Chiaotzu, who controls the Dodon Wave.
Krillin has his hands full as he continues his battle against Chiaotzu, who unleashes an even deadlier attack than the Dodon Wave!
In the fourth fight of the quarterfinals of the tournament Goku meets Panput, the world-famous fighter and action star.
The semifinal round begins with an extraordinary fight between the young Tien and the experienced champion Jackie Chun.
The fight between Jackie Chun and Tien takes on epic proportions as they continue their struggle, using every trick and technique in the book!
In the sixth fight of the World Martial Arts Tournament, friends become enemies as Goku and Krillin go head-to-head.
The battle between Goku and Krillin comes to a head. What started as a friendly fight turns into an all-out war after Krillin pulls a sneaky stunt behind Goku's back.
The final match in the 22nd World Martial Arts Tournament is about to begin! Goku faces Tien in a thrilling battle to see who will become the next Master of Martial Arts!
Bruised and on the brink of destruction, Goku finds himself at the mercy of Tien, as the final match in the World Martial Arts Tournament continues.  Who will win the ultimate battle?
A dramatic turn of events infuriates Tien and brings him to renewed focus and determination. There is only one outcome that satisfies the proud Tien, as he unveils a sinister new attack!
Tien prepares to unleash the destructive power of the Spirit Cannon!
The Spirit Cannon has left both fighters weary and exhausted. With the stage destroyed, Tien and Goku plummet towards the Earth, with the one who lands first losing the fight!
While Goku sets out on a quest for revenge, his friends try to discover the identity of Krillin's killer. All the clues lead to Master Roshi's past and a demon named King Piccolo!
King Piccolo has begun his sinister plan to conquer the world. All he needs are the seven Dragon Balls and the death of all the members of the Martial Arts Society.
King Piccolo has sent Tambourine to kill all the warriors that could foil his plan. Goku meets a mountain man - but is he friend or foe?
Goku fights for his honor after a mountain boy accuses him of stealing his fish. Meanwhile, Goku's friends desperately search for a way to stop King Piccolo's evil plan.

Tambourine continues his campaign to slaughter the martial artists and sets his sight on Yamcha! Master Roshi embarks on a race for the Dragon Balls to stay ahead of the competition, King Piccolo and his dastardly horde.
Tambourine closes in on Goku and Yajirobe. To obtain one of the Dragon Balls, Tien must atone for the brutality of his past.
While Goku fights Tambourine to avenge Krillin's death, Master Roshi, Tien, and Chiaotzu continue their race against King Piccolo for the Dragon Balls.
Goku fights for his life as King Piccolo seeks revenge for the deaths of Cymbal and Tambourine.

Goku makes a final stand against the seemingly indestructable King Piccolo. As Master Roshi and others continue their pursuit of the Dragon Balls, it becomes clear that the trail leads to the dark forces of King Piccolo.
Master Roshi answers the call for a hero by placing himself between King Piccolo and the remaining Dragon Balls. However, in his attempt to save the world, he may have to pay the ultimate price.
Having summoned the Eternal Dragon and with no one to oppose him, King Piccolo prepares to make a wish that, if granted, could become the world's greatest nightmare!
King Piccolo sets out to conquer the world and he begins with the peaceful inhabitants of King Furry's realm. Meanwhile, Goku hopes to regain his strength by visiting Master Korin's Tower.

Goku's reunion with Master Korin is tinged with hope and disappointment as the hero learns shocking news! Meanwhile, King Piccolo tries to force King Furry's obedience by displaying a cruel brutality towards his kingdom.
Goku embarks on a dangerous quest to find Ultra Divine Water. One sip could mean incredible power - or a painful death!
Goku finally finds Darkness, the keeper of the Ultra Divine Water. After Goku proves himself worthy, Darkness allows him to drink the dangerous potion. But will it make him stronger or will he die?

Goku and Yajirobe return to Korin's tower, where Goku discovers his new powers and receives another Nimbus cloud. Meanwhile, Tien has mastered the Evil Containment Wave and decides to use it against King Piccolo.

King Piccolo has declared the destruction of the world, one sector at a time. First up is the Western City, home to Bulma's parents. Tien prepares to fight King Piccolo, but a new threat looms over everyone.
Tien must go through Drum before he can fight King Piccolo. The problem is that Drum moves faster than all three of Tien's eyes!
Only Goku stands between King Piccolo and the destruction of Western City. It's more than just a rematch, it's the fight to save the world!
Goku is not ready to give up power to King Piccolo without a fight. It's a fierce battle, but even Goku has his limits. How much can he take?
King Piccolo gains the advantage as he dissects Goku limb by limb. Will he surrender to King Piccolo or decide to fight and risk his own life?
The Secret of the Nyoi-BōGoku learns that there may be a way to revive his lost friends - a face-to-face meeting with the creator of the Dragon Balls!
Goku uses his Power Pole to climb to Kami's temple in the sky. When he gets there, he has to face Kami's assistant Mr. Popo in a test of strength.

The moment has come when Goku will come face to face with the amazing Kami, the Guardian of Earth! But even the wise Korin could not prepare Goku for what he will see when the mysterious guardian appears!
Kami agrees to revive the Eternal Dragon if Goku trains for 3 years for the next World Martial Arts Tournament.
Goku's first task is a death-defying mission to the top of Mount Rumble to get the legendary Sacred Crown. To complete this task, he will have to be faster than lightning.
In search of a worthy sparring partner, Goku stumbles upon a surprising discovery hidden deep within the secluded labyrinth.

Goku travels through time where he meets a young Master Roshi and Master Shen! While the two rivals fight for the affections of the same girl, Goku tries to gain a new power with the help of Master Mutaito.
When Goku asks Mr. Popo for the ultimate sparring partner for his training, he gets the fight of his life!

Tien, Yamcha, Chiaotzu and Krillin are sidetracked by a village celebrating a mysterious festival in honor of its mountain spirit. When the mountain erupts, it's up to our heroes to contain the active volcano!
Tien, Yamcha, Chiaotzu and Krillin find themselves in a very hot situation! It's time to put their new training to the test!

Warriors all over the world are lining up to compete as the World Martial Arts Tournament prepares to get under way. Unfortunately, the entry-deadline is approaching and all of Master Roshi's students are missing.
Goku and the others compete in the exciting preliminary round. But the competition threatens to turn ugly when Goku gets a visit from an old adversary.
Goku, Yamcha, Krillin, and Tien battle one opponent after another in hopes of advancing to the semi-final round. Meanwhile, Master Roshi is confronted by an old rival.
The Tournament begins with the fight between Tien and his former mentor turned cyborg, Mercenary Tao.

In the second fight of the World Martial Arts Tournament, Goku faces his most beautiful opponent yet. The identity of the beautiful warrior is as mysterious as her fierce anger towards Goku, who must win the fight to learn her real name.
The tournament continues with a double header! First up, Krillin battles Piccolo Junior. Yamcha jumps in the ring next, opposing Shen, whose meek appearance may hide a darker threat.
Yamcha scratches to stay in the ring as Shen reveals his true ability and identity. Later, Goku and Tien must face off in the semifinals.
Goku unloads a heavy burden, one that may shift the balance in the epic showdown. All eyes turn to Tien as an embarrassing moment spurs him to make a dangerous decision.
When Goku's fight with Tien turns into a war against an army, he finds himself in great danger. Tien's new technique could mean the end for our hero!
Goku is eager to fight Piccolo Junior, but Kami fears that his inexperience will be his downfall. Shen faces Junior in the semifinals, where his shocking plan is revealed.
In the final round of the tournament, Goku faces off against his greatest nemesis. This time it's about more than just the title. The future of the world is at stake!
Goku has an ultimate weapon: The Super Kamehameha Wave. However, if he uses it to destroy Piccolo, Kami, who is trapped inside Junior's stomach, will be sacrificed.
Piccolo reveals a startling secret that shocks the audience. Goku faces a major dilemma, because the fight for the championship becomes a fight for survival!
As the exhausting battle between Goku and Piccolo continues, Junior surprises everyone when he reveals a new threat!.
Piccolo unveils a technique that threatens to destroy Goku and his friends. Even Kami believes that there is no way for Goku to survive in this massacre!
Goku struggles to survive when Piccolo gets the upper hand. Kami devises a way to save the young hero, but his plan requires the ultimate sacrifice!
Goku and Chi-Chi return to her father's kingdom. But the Ox-King's castle goes up in flames!
Goku and Chi-Chi's search for the Bansho Fan leads them into the heart of a volcano. There they must face a powerful creature that consumes flames: the Fire-Eater!
Goku's search for the Bansho Fan leads him to a mountain with a strange curse on it. Meanwhile, Ox-King tries to escape from the raging fires that threaten to destroy his castle!
Goku and Chi-Chi set out to find the Magic Furnace, which is considered the last hope to put out the fire. But before they can finish their search, Goku must solve the mystery of the Dark World.
Goku and Chi-Chi must travel to Mount Five Element in a last ditch effort to save her father.
4295: Scrooge and Glomgold argue over the price of Glomgold's Far West island of Duckbill, which, unbeknownst to Glomgold, has a diamond mine.
Scrooge and co. attempt to go back to the present but end up in a land governed by a tyrant, who has Scrooge and Launchpad captured.
When Scrooge returns home, Gyro tells him that he may have changed history by bringing Bubba back, and that Bubba must be returned.
Scrooge blames his misfortunes on Bubba and treats him unfairly. Glomgold convinces the police that Scrooge is an impostor and they throw him in jail.
Returning to Duckbill Island, Scooge and Co. attempt to get a diamond from the mine to pay Glomgold, but Glomgold is already there.
When Scrooge's new accountant, Fenton, discovers the Beagle Boys' plan to steal the money bin, he dumps the money into Lake Doughbegone to hide it.
When the Lake Doughbegone dam breaks and Scrooge's cash sweeps downstream, Scrooge freezes the relocated lake to regain his cash.
GizmoDuck becomes a sensation and Scrooge hires him as a security guard. But Ma Beagle uses a remote control device to make GizmoDuck do her bidding.
With her newly acquired money bin, Ma Beagle buys Scrooge's mansion and has him thrown in jail, and it's up to the nephews to save the day.
When an alien spacecraft takes away Scrooge's money bin, Scrooge and company travel in a rocket to a planet populated by robots to get the bin back.
Scrooge reaches the breaking point when dealing with glad-handers and curses his money. His doctor recommends a vacation to a land without money.
The nephews want a new bike that's on sale, but they don't get their allowance till Saturday, so they try to convince Scrooge it's already Saturday.
Bubba falls in love with Julie, the new girl next door. But trouble brews when Bubba's parents win the lottery and begin feuding with Scrooge.
Scrooge's Sowbuggian crown jewel exhibit at the Duckburg museum becomes a target for a jewel heist for the Beagle Boys' three cousins.
Mrs. Crackshell receives a jolt of electricity from her TV set and can now predict the future, so Scrooge has her predict stock market trends for him.
Gyro needs a challenge and Mrs. Beakley needs help with the housework, so Gyro invents Robotica, who falls for GizmoDuck and makes his life crazy.
The nephews need more allowance money and start a service called the Dirtbusters. While employed by Gyro, they stumble across a duplicator.
Bubba's grades are deplorable, so Gyro invents a thinking cap for him. Unfortunately, not only does Bubba's brain expand, but so does his ego.
Fenton has created demand for a new product before there was even a product, so he uses Gyro's new helium-based chewing gum -- without testing it.
Fenton becomes jealous when the nephews conclude that Launchpad must be GizmoDuck. The rumor spreads, and Launchpad enjoys the limelight -- at first.
As Scrooge contemplates selling his skateboard factory, he gets hit on the head by a skateboard, develops amnesia and strikes against his own factory.
The Beagle Boys win a contest with their hit "Boogie Beagle Blues." Scrooge owns their record label and helps out when manager Ma becomes difficult.
Scrooge takes a dip into his money bin, comes down with loot lice and is quarantined. The nephews decide to fill in for him and become entrepreneurs.
When Ma Beagle convinces the court that she's Scrooge's wife and moves into the mansion, Scrooge must come up with a plan to expose Ma's charade.
When Gyro invents an unbreakable glass, Scrooge has his money bin sheathed in the stuff and mistakenly believes the bin is now impenetrable.
Webby, who's been feeling neglected, accidentally turns into a 50-foot giant after falling into a magical spring and becomes the center of attention.
Hoping to change his poor public image, Scrooge becomes the Masked Mallard, a costumed do-gooder who goes about the city fighting crime.
When Scrooge and Glomgold discover there's gold on Glittering Goldie's property, they vie for her affection in order to purchase her land.
In order to get time off for a ski trip, Fenton pretends to be bedridden. He then stumbles on a plot by enemy agents to steal Scrooge's gold shipment.
Scrooge believes his days are numbered and has Fenton put his affairs in order. Somehow, Scrooge's money physically gets lost in his computer.
5307: To prove that he doesn't need Genie's help to be a hero, Aladdin decides to face the mad scientist Mechanikles and his army of flying robot bugs alone when they threaten a small town full of cowards.
While traveling through the desert, the group is lured into a false oasis. It turns out to be a trap to catch food for the underground-dwelling, carnivorous mud creatures Al Muddi.
6459: Musician Ricky Mathis becomes an overnight sensation thanks to his song "Rock Legend." When his music causes his fans to become obsessive and destructive, three young girls named Sam, Alex, and Clover are called in to investigate the cause of this fanatical behaviour under the guise of a supporting band. While Clover is enchanted by Ricky's music, Sam and Alex investigate the recording studio and discover they are using special glowing CDs that brainwash listeners. They must stop manager Sebastian Saga from using Ricky's music to take over the world. In the subplot, Clover has a crush on schoolmate Damon Reynolds, who plays guitar and hangs out with school diva and rival Mandy.

Fed up of Jerry's butting in to their personal lives and treating them like children, the girls are happy to see the young Mac Smit takes over as the head of WOOHP. Their happiness is short-lived when Mac's generous gifts turn out to be death traps. The girls discover that Mac is actually a criminal and former employee named Tim Scam (Mac Smit is Tim's name spelled backwards), who has sent Jerry into orbit and who plans to use his inventions to vaporise the world's oceans as revenge for being fired from WOOHP.

The girls return from an intense mission, but mess up in the subsequent school track and field meet. Jerry sends them to Hawaii to relax. Alex falls for a surfer guy named Corey, who is a research student for a volcano expert who has gone missing. After some surfing, Corey suddenly vanishes in a pile of dust, so the girls visit Iceland to consult with the scientist there. Returning to Hawaii, the girls discover that a madman called Hephaestus, a scientist whose face was disfigured by volcanic magma, is planning to make the volcanoes of the world erupt simultaneously. After failing to stop the lava in time, the girls soon learn the entire situation is just a W.O.O.H.P field test (Hephaestus is Jerry in disguise, while Corey is just a pimply guy named Morey), but they soon get pulled into a real emergency when the volcano erupts for real. The girls return in time for the school dance, but its theme is a Hawaiian luau with volcanoes.

The girls are sent to investigate the kidnappings of various military personnel and scientists by a mysterious knight. When they end up in the middle of another kidnapping, they follow the criminal through a strange portal, transporting them back to medieval England in the year 1136, 865 years ago. The knight reveals himself as a Malibu teen who wants to overthrow the benevolent king by using his modern technology, and takes Clover as his queen. It is up to Sam and Alex to stop him before the timeline is forever changed. In the subplot, the girls compete against Mandy for the best costume at the annual Halloween dance.

When villains disappear for no apparent reason, Clover suspects a shanigan led by the cats of the bad guys. But before she can prove it, she is kidnapped by 3 felines with the appearance of angels ready to do anything to infiltrate WOOHP.

An obsession with knitting revives mammoths to become the queen of hand-knitted sweaters. The spies must act quickly to prevent the arrival of a new ice age, especially because of Alex's overcycling, Clover no longer has a single sweater!

When several snowboarding champions go missing, the Spies are sent on a mission to Switzerland alongside Blaine to infiltrate a competition. Mysterious mythical creatures are said to be behind it all, But how can they be stopped?

Strange flights shake Singapore and all indicators point to La Crado, who is already in prison. The spies will have to temporarily ally with the criminal queen of disorder to find her double criminal.

The Spies must save Singapore, which is under siege by excited babies and their terrible chasm-creating toys. Behind this attack is Cyberchac, whose goal is to find the WOOHP World by weakening the shield that protects it.Cyberchac nearly breaks into WOOHP World, but is thwarted by Sam at the last moment. Despite this they still manage to get away.

To foil a Machiavellian plan, the Spies must pose as super villains leading an army of henchmen. Alex discovers that she loves to indulge her dark side, is she in danger of losing herself and going too far?
The Spies and Toby's training day is sabotaged - but by whom?

The spies ecological perspectives, and especially Alex's, are called into question when they find themselves face to face with the creator of walking durians who attack polluting factories in the Amazon, destroying everything in their path.

Something is turning AIYA upside down every night, and Zerlina goes undercover to investigate, with the help of the Spies. But as the pressure mounts on Zerlina, the girls discover that having their boss as a teacher isn't as cool as they'd hoped!
